newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria May producer prices rise 0.47 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria May producer prices rise 0.47 pct m/m.

text.p: Bulgaria's producer price inflation was 0.47 percent month on month in May and 1,455.8 percent year on year, a National Statistics Institute (NSI) official said on Thursday.
"Producer prices rose only slightly last month. The stability of lev/dollar exchange rate prevented sharp gains of import prices," a NSI official, who declined to be named told Reuters.
Bulgaria depends strongly on imports of energy resources and raw materials for its industrial output.

The lev traded between 1,500-1,650 per dollar in May on the local interbank market as Bulgaria prepared to introduce a restrictive fixed exchange rate mechanism called a currency board from July 1 to stabilise the economy. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
